$comment: TWO FAMILIES ONLY. Part 4 §16 R-B cut IBM Plex Serif: it served one route and its
'serif = argument' semantics were already carried by layout and the 68ch measure.
The surviving epistemic distinction (§5.0) is the one that does real work:
mono = measurement (values produced by the pipeline)
TWO SCALES. `interface` is dense (13px base) for tables and controls; `document`
is 17px for sustained reading. A single scale cannot serve both (§5.1.3).
`document` tokens are legal only inside DocRenderer — asserted in scripts/check.ts.

family.$comment: --font-plex-* are emitted by next/font in app/layout.tsx, which self-hosts the files at build time. The fallbacks apply only if that asset fails to load.

interface.$comment: base 13px, ratio ~1.2 (minor third). Tight steps so adjacent sizes stay distinguishable in dense UI.

document.$comment: base 17px, ratio 1.25. Measure capped at 68ch — below ~45ch the eye returns too often, above ~75ch it loses the line on return sweep.

measure.$comment: Maximum line length for sustained reading (§5.1.3).
